data:
Hey, I'm Alessandro Quets. I'm a digital designer specialized in UX/UI and frontend development, with experience in creating and managing design systems for digital products.

I translate complex requirements into coherent, scalable interfaces, handling both design and development to ensure continuity between design and code.
Representing the motto "From Abstractness to Concreteness"

Website for the conference Eksig 2023: From Abstractness to Concreteness. Experiential knowledge and the role of prototypes in design research, hosted by the Department of Design of Politecnico di Milano.

An interactive and generative cover has been designed for the website to symbolize the transition from the abstract nature of a concept to the tangible reality of a prototype.
